approval.note: Approved in chat ("yeah do it all"). The §7 answers below were taken by Claude under that blanket approval, not dictated by the owner; every one is reversible by editing this file and re-running build_brief.py.

answers.1: **(c) Frozen at 2.0.8.** No further PyPI releases of `lazylabel-gui`; the existing release stays installable so the desktop app remains available until Phase 6 exit. Revisit if the owner wants the package to keep shipping the Python inference client.
answers.2: **Python/PyTorch inference service**, reusing the legacy model code. The target is therefore React/Node.js plus a Python inference service, not Node.js alone. An in-browser ONNX decoder stays a Phase 3 fallback if click latency needs it.
answers.3: **Single-user self-hosted first.** One trusted user per deployment, no tenant isolation in this plan. Every API route still carries a user scope so multi-tenancy is an added check rather than a redesign. Upload limits are sized for one annotator.
answers.4: **JSON string in a unicode array** (`class_aliases` written as a single JSON document), plus an offline converter for existing pickled files. No code path unpickles.
answers.5: **PostgreSQL plus S3-compatible object storage**, as in §2. For a self-hosted deployment that is Postgres and MinIO in the same compose file. Annotation files stay the interchange format, produced by export rather than stored as the source of truth.
answers.6: **Keep legacy per-image class ids and aliases.** Exported ids must match legacy exports byte for byte, which a project-wide label map would break. A project label map may be layered on later as an optional view.
answers.7: **Explicit save with dirty tracking.** Do not reproduce delete-on-empty, the silent loss on close, or the silent loss on multi-view navigation. Deleting annotation files requires explicit user action, and a failed load never presents as "no annotations".
answers.8: **Rebuild multi-view as a synchronized split view** from the linked-operation rules, and delete the half-migrated legacy path rather than porting it. Reassess at Phase 6 entry if the restored rules prove too thin to specify it.
answers.9: Per-image-size crop restore: **do not carry over**, a crop applies to the current image only. Deletion: **make it undoable** in the web app. Image formats: **support .bmp, .gif and .webp** in addition to the legacy five. COCO versus YOLO polygon simplification: **keep the legacy difference** so exports stay equivalent, and record it in the format library. Propagation confidence threshold: **persist it** with the other settings.
answers.10: Text, JSON and XML exports **byte-identical after normalizing line endings**. The legacy writers open files in text mode, so they emit CRLF on Windows and LF elsewhere; the target always writes LF, and the differential tests compare normalized bytes. Everything else about those files must match exactly, including Python's `json.dump` defaults: non-ASCII class names escaped as `\uXXXX` (`ensure_ascii=True`) and the same key order and separators. NPZ **array-identical**, except the alias encoding from decision 4. SAM masks **IoU at least 0.98** against legacy output on golden prompts. Display adjustments and thresholds **within 1/255 per channel**.
answers.11: Answered per rule on the cards in `BUSINESS_RULES.md`. Questions that restate a judge's fidelity finding are answered by correcting the specification from that finding; questions that are product choices are answered by the decisions above.
answers.12: **One slice at a time.** Keep each fan-out under about 40 agents, and resume an interrupted workflow rather than restarting it. Rule extraction needed four runs for want of this rule.
answers.13: **No.** The ruff `*.md` exclude stays on `main-web` only.
answers.14: **(c) Restore the split rules whose work lands in Phase 1 or Phase 4**, listed in `restoreP0` below. The two that land only in Phase 3 or Phase 6 stay P1 and are revisited at those phases' entry.
answers.15: **(a) Contour order.** The format library must reproduce OpenCV's `RETR_EXTERNAL` / `CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE` enumeration order, because line order is visible in the exported file. The Phase 1 pilot proves it on randomized masks; if a hand-written tracer cannot match, take an OpenCV WebAssembly build. **(b) Import encoding.** Read label text files as UTF-8 and strip a leading byte-order mark. This matches a Linux legacy install and fixes the BOM-becomes-a-class bug, and diverges from a Windows legacy install only for non-ASCII class names. **(c) Failed loads.** A file that fails to parse is reported and stops the chain; the rewrite never falls through to a lower-priority file, never applies aliases from a rejected file, and never deletes anything on that path. Partial results from a failed loader are discarded, so a load is all-or-nothing per format. **(d) Surfacing a failed load.** A persistent per-image banner plus a badge on the file list row, never a silent empty canvas and never a modal that blocks annotation. **(e) Sidecar naming.** Keep legacy suffix matching on the image base name, so existing datasets keep loading the same files. Record the hazard that `foo.png` and `foo.jpg` share sidecars. **(f) Stale sidecars.** When a save does not update a sidecar that exists for that image, warn and offer removal. Never delete silently. **(g) Alias reuse.** Preserve the legacy behavior where a freed class id inherits the deleted class's alias, since it changes export content. Flag it for a later release that may break byte-identity. **(h) Crop off-by-one.** Preserve it, including the always-cleared last row and column. Same later-release caveat. **(i) Wording.** Ship the corrected Skip Labeled wording, "any supported annotation file", and document in the library that LazyLabel's Pascal VOC files are 0-based and half-open, so they are not devkit-compatible.

restoreP0: COCO JSON export structure and area
Pascal VOC export uses alias names and exclusive max bounds
Eraser splits segments and drops pieces of 10 pixels or less
New segments take the active class, otherwise the next free class id (highest + 1)
Reassign class ids from class table order
Shape rasterization before export (truncated vertices, rounded circles)
Crop is clamped to the image and blanks everything outside it on save, including the last row and column
COCO JSON import with polygon-then-box fallback
Pascal VOC and CreateML import rules
YOLO Detection import validation, rounding and clamping
Undoing an erase inserts malformed segment records
Closing the application never saves the open image's annotations
Leaving the Sequence tab or clicking New Timeline discards all sequence work without saving
Sidecar file naming and suffix collisions
